observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of the head of a sewing machine with a black and gold decorative plate, mounted on a bright orange surface. The machine has a metallic needle and thread guide.
Photo 1 shows the same head from a slightly different angle, with the 'TWO LION' logo clearly visible on the black plate. The orange surface and metal latches are visible.

Photo 2 shows the full head of the machine from a side angle, with 'TWO LION' written in gold letters on the black body. The machine is mounted on a wooden surface, and the needle is threaded. The background includes a window and some items on a shelf.
The machine appears to be a vintage-style hand-sewing machine, likely from the early to mid-20th century.
The orange surface is likely a cabinet or stand, not part of the machine itself.
The machine is not shown in operation; no motion or sound is visible.
The seller claims it is 'neatly used' and 'available for sale in Ibadan'.

claims.evidence: The brand and model are visible in photos 2 and 1, but the condition 'neatly used' and 'available for sale in Ibadan' cannot be verified from the photos alone. No proof of usage or location is provided.
The seller mentions accessories and manual, but no photos show them. The claim is incomplete and cannot be verified remotely.
